description: Look up Brazilian companies by CNPJ number using the BrasilAPI free endpoint. Returns official Receita Federal data.

cnpjs.description: List of Brazilian CNPJ numbers to look up. Can include formatting (dots, slashes, hyphens) or plain 14-digit numbers. Example: ["18.236.120/0001-58", "47960950000121"].
cnpjs.title: CNPJ Numbers

includePartners.description: Whether to include the company's partner/shareholder list (Quadro Societário de Administração) in the output.
includePartners.title: Include Partners (QSA)

includeSecondaryActivities.description: Whether to include the list of secondary CNAE industry codes in the output.
includeSecondaryActivities.title: Include Secondary CNAE Activities

title: BrasilAPI CNPJ Company Scraper Input
